records.name: A-2SO Robot
records.describe: An isometric model of the A-S2O robot, superbly restored. If you ask Paladi what the name "A-S2O" means, you will likely be answered with incredibly long descriptions... Better to do that when you have free time.

records.name: Island Stacked Aquarium

records.idCN: 海岛/休闲/大型智能水族箱
records.name: Large Intelligence Aquarium
records.describe: This large island-style intelligent aquarium, made of high-transparency glass, removes the metal cover of its smaller peer and boasts a stereo system, although it might make one wonder which fish would actually listen to music.\nAll the fish housed within provide 10% more Aquatic Rating.

records.idCN: 相框/城市限定/勘察·汇流塔
records.name: Explore – Confluence Tower
records.describe: A commemorative image captured by the Basilisk from the offshore platform near the Confluence Tower. In the distance, the tower looks like an eternal landmark on the sea.

records.idCN: 相框/城市限定/勘察·海角城
records.name: Explore – Cape City
records.describe: A commemorative image captured by the Basilisk near Cape City, featuring a flock of white seabirds sweeping across the sky above the peaceful Cape City.

records.name: Pala, dee!
records.describe: This image depicts Paladi working diligently at the Reforming Center. Once she sounds the alarm, no bad guys can ever escape from her!

records.name: Wobbling Livia
records.describe: An inflatable model designed based on Livia's image. Due to its overly large size, it wobbles when poked... No, Livia never wobbles!\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 5%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.

records.idCN: 通行证/11月_纯金大亨·图浩
records.name: Gold Tycoon – Wealt
records.describe: This statue, said to be made of pure gold, depicts Wealt using his financial power to "convince" the merchants at Mander Mine. According to Wealt, the statue only captures a fraction of his dominance, but it is still considered a fine piece of art.

records.name: The Eternal·Iron Saga
records.describe: An imaginative painting, reimagining the Eternal modified by a talented girl from another world. While it may seem unusual, it brings a unique charm to the train from a fresh perspective.

records.name: Wall Painting – Vassago
records.describe: This painting, which mysteriously appeared one day, features a train shrouded in mystery, with a stylish signature reading "Dr. Aoi" on the back... Could that have been its previous pilot?

records.idCN: 相框/挂画·光子力无限号
records.name: Wall Painting – Photon Infinite
records.describe: This painting portrays an enigmatic train powered by a mysterious energy source known as 'Photon Power.' The train in the artwork seems to glow with a magical light, as though it could transform at any moment.

records.name: Conductor's Adventure
records.describe: A model inspired by the chibi version of the Eternal and its conductor. Imagine riding a dragon... No, riding the Eternal!!\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 3%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.

records.name: Celestial Sphere
records.describe: A gilded celestial sphere found in a guest room at the ONEderland Hotel, showcasing intricate craftsmanship and appearing highly valuable. Initially mistaken as part of a mysterious ritual, it was later revealed to be a mere decorative piece.

records.name: Ballota
records.describe: This photo captures Pelota suddenly appearing in front of the camera and accidentally triggering the shutter. "Call me Ballie!"

records.idCN: 相框/城市限定/鸟瞰·远星大桥

records.idCN: 相框/城市限定/勘察·远星大桥
records.name: Explore – Apoaster Bridge

records.name: Advent of Hayajiro

records.name: Cape City Plaque
records.describe: A metal plaque bestowed upon individuals for remarkable contributions to Cape City's security and development. Crafted by Mayor Aleister, this plaque exudes a stylish and classic design, embodying Cape City's essence.

records.name: Modern Dining Chair
records.describe: Designed by the COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce, the dining chairs from the "Modern Dining Car" furniture series feature bright colors that can uplift diners' moods.\nDelicacy Rating of the carriage +1%, stackable.

records.name: Modern Dining Table
records.describe: The dining table equipped in the "Modern Diner Car" series of furniture designed by COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce. The curved edges allow for more dining space, bringing everyone closer together.\nDelicacy rating in the carriage +3%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.

records.name: Modern Cooking Set
records.describe: Designed by the COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce, the "modern dining car" series furniture is equipped with a set of electric steam and electric ovens, featuring stable temperature control and an attractive appearance. Use with caution to avoid burns!\nDelicacy Rating in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.

records.name: Modern Gas Cooker
records.describe: Designed by the COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce, the "Modern Dining Car" series furniture includes an integrated gas stove and a dishwashing cabinet with a disinfection function. \nDelicacy Rating in the carriage +3%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.

records.name: Modern Cooking Table
records.describe: The sink and cooking station set equipped in the "Modern Dining Car" furniture series designed by COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce. Simple and classic, easy to keep tidy.\nDelicacy rating in the carriage +5%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.

records.name: Modern Refrigerator
records.describe: The double-door refrigerator equipped in the "Modern Dining Car" furniture series designed by the COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce. A label on the door reads, "The posture of a train assistant helping the conductor write reports is as reliable as this double-door refrigerator!"... Who wrote that?!\nRefrigerator capacity +36.

records.name: Ur Shana
records.describe: Ushana focusedly staring at the camera. "Master Savior! Leave it to me!"

records.name: Useful Insulated Box

records.name: Model HelloBox

records.name: Model HowlingBox
records.describe: A box that occasionally drops from HowlingBox. It looks so mighty!

records.name: Beverage Cabinet
records.describe: This elegant beverage cabinet was originally designed for alcohol storage. However, due to the presence of numerous young members in the Eternal crew, it now houses a diverse selection of beverages.

records.name: Explore – Tattle Station

records.name: Ranshin Plaque

records.name: Promise

records.name: "A Glance"
records.describe: A portrait. About Raziel, about her, about me.

records.name: At Your Service

records.name: Float·Howl

records.name: Float·Pumpkin Carriage
records.describe: One of the commemorative float models provided by Night Chains Land. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.

records.name: Romantic Ferris Wheel

records.name: Witch's Home

records.name: Simulated Fountain

records.name: Broom Highway

Bonus limited once for identical furniture.

records.name: Mini Divination Room
